title: Yeah, But...
coreMove: Turn a yeah-but objection into a design constraint instead of letting it excuse fear-based behavior.
sourcePressure: Tests practical objections to safety-first leadership and separates useful constraints from excuse language that preserves blame, distance, or social threat.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating every objection as cynicism, or treating pressure as proof that safety is unrealistic.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.audience: ramp lead facing a late departure
exampleSpecs.stakes: speed pressure is used to skip a safety cross-check
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the lead says the delay is real and moves one loader to verify the cargo pins anyway
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a cargo pin tag snapping in jet wash

exampleSpecs.stakes: care language is dismissed as impossible under volume
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she marks the chemo patient who needs a chair near the bathroom and then rebuilds the grid
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a printed chair grid under a highlighter

exampleSpecs.stakes: tradition says hurry and hope the tarp holds

exampleSpecs.stakes: case volume tempts a shallow client interview

exampleSpecs.stakes: fragile artifacts may be rushed into cases
